The '''Marauder's Mace''' was a type of [[Mace (weapon)/Legends|weapon]] used sometime during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Reveal" />
